timeline.summary: Pravin Kumar Brijendra Kumar Agarwal, Managing Director and Chairman, declared no promoter share encumbrance or acquisition under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4) as of March 31, 2026.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹149.05 Cr (+82.7% YoY), net profit ₹34.46 Cr (+91.1% YoY).

Shareholders via remote e-voting, on 06.06.2026, approved **IVIR. KRISHINAKUMAR LAXMINIAR BANGERA** (DIN: UZU8Z675) as Non-Executive Independent Director (Regulation 17(1A) SEBI LODR) with 99.9951% votes in favor.
Board of Directors declared an Interim Dividend of Rs.0.03 per equity share, record date 23 October 2026, payable by 14 November 2026.
